body:
Validated on 504cd767: the unchanged final Bash guard passes all three clean layout fixtures with optional files absent (Git 2.55.0); these path filters do not require existence.
All eleven mutation controls reject changes, including six staged/untracked/ignored creations; conditional omission would remove that protection.
Retain the complete input list; no product change. The cancelled CI run remains a separate merge hold.
[Decision, options, scores, native results and Git references](https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide/blob/301e139d0170a323b88e2bdadfc750fa5ea6cd06/docs/planning/action-items-2026-10-02/results/A06/PS-TF68-carryback/PR235-round1-R1/REPORT.md)

@@ -0,0 +1,887 @@
+name: Copilot code review preparation
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - "**"
+    paths:
+      - .github/workflows/**
+      - .husky/**
+      - requirements-dev.txt
+      - "**/*.yml"
+      - "**/*.yaml"
+      - .npmrc
+      - npm-shrinkwrap.json
+      - package.json
+      - package-lock.json
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - .github/workflows/**
+      - .husky/**
+      - requirements-dev.txt
+      - "**/*.yml"
+      - "**/*.yaml"
+      - .npmrc
+      - npm-shrinkwrap.json
+      - package.json
+      - package-lock.json
+
+# Review setup prepares tools and hooks. Complete validation remains in
+# ordinary CI and the coding-agent setup; readiness is not acceptance.
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  copilot-setup-steps:
+    name: Prepare locked code review tools and hooks
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 59
+    permissions: {}
+    steps:
+      - name: Acquire triggering revision without an action
+        timeout-minutes: 5
+        id: acquire
+        shell: pwsh
+        env:
+          GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1"
+          GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: /dev/null
+          GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0"
+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+
+          # Do not load user/system Git credentials or hooks during anonymous acquisition.
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_COUNT) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: external Git command configuration is not allowed'
+          }
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM = '1'
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL = '/dev/null'
+          $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT = '0'
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GITHUB_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GH_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: a token was projected into a code job'
+          }
+          # git reports absent state with a non-zero status in places this step
+          # accepts, so native-command error mapping is disabled the same way
+          # the other governed steps disable it and each status is classified
+          # explicitly instead.
+          if (Test-Path Variable:PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference) {
+              $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
+          }
+
+          # Every value below is set by the runner before any repository code
+          # executes, and is read from the environment rather than expanded as
+          # a workflow expression, because no governed script step in this
+          # repository contains an expression at all.
+          $strServerUrl = $env:GITHUB_SERVER_URL
+          $strRepository = $env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY
+          $strSha = $env:GITHUB_SHA
+          if ($strServerUrl -cne 'https://github.com') {
+              throw 'acquire: the runner named an unexpected server'
+          }
+          if ($strRepository -cne 'franklesniak/PSStyleGuide') {
+              throw 'acquire: the triggering repository is not the expected repository'
+          }
+          # A full 40-hex commit is required rather than a ref. A ref would let
+          # the fetch resolve to whatever the ref points at when the fetch runs,
+          # which for a push to a busy branch is not necessarily the revision
+          # that triggered this run.
+          if ($strSha -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') {
+              throw 'acquire: the triggering revision is not a full commit hash'
+          }
+
+          # The workspace is proven empty rather than cleaned. Cleaning would
+          # decide what to delete from state that is already present, while an
+          # emptiness assertion has no such input.
+          if (@([System.IO.Directory]::EnumerateFileSystemEntries($PWD.Path)).Count -ne 0) {
+              throw 'acquire: the workspace is not empty'
+          }
+
+          # Resolved from a fixed candidate list rather than by name. Nothing has
+          # executed in this step yet, so name resolution is not attacker-
+          # influenced here -- but PowerShell aliases curl and wget to
+          # Invoke-WebRequest on the Desktop edition, this repository already
+          # pins the Git executable this way in the verify step, and relying on
+          # an alias being absent is a property of the host rather than
+          # something this file asserts. Constant, so nothing later can rebind
+          # it.
+          $strResolvedGit = @('/usr/bin/git', '/bin/git') | Where-Object { [System.IO.File]::Exists($_) } | Select-Object -First 1
+          if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($strResolvedGit)) { throw 'acquire: Git was not resolved as an application' }
+          New-Variable -Name strGitPath -Value $strResolvedGit -Option Constant
+
+          & $strGitPath -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null init --quiet .
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "acquire: git init exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
+          & $strGitPath remote add origin "$strServerUrl/$strRepository"
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "acquire: git remote add exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
+          # Fetching the commit itself, not a ref that names it. No credential
+          # is supplied and none is configured, so nothing is persisted for the
+          # next step to have to clean up.
+          for ($intAttempt = 1; $intAttempt -le 3; $intAttempt++) {
+              & $strGitPath -c credential.helper= -c http.extraheader= -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null fetch --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules origin $strSha
+              $intFetchExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
+              if ($intFetchExitCode -eq 0) { break }
+              if ($intAttempt -lt 3) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }
+          }
+          if ($intFetchExitCode -ne 0) { throw "acquire: git fetch exited $intFetchExitCode after three attempts" }
+          & $strGitPath -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null checkout --quiet --detach FETCH_HEAD
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "acquire: git checkout exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
+          $arrHeadOutput = @(& $strGitPath rev-parse HEAD)
+          $intHeadExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
+          if ($intHeadExitCode -ne 0) {
+              throw "acquire: git rev-parse exited $intHeadExitCode"
+          }
+          if ($arrHeadOutput.Count -ne 1) {
+              throw 'acquire: git rev-parse must return exactly one line'
+          }
+          $strHead = $arrHeadOutput[0].Trim()
+          if ($strHead -cne $strSha) {
+              throw 'acquire: the checked out revision is not the triggering revision'
+          }
+          Write-Information "acquire: anonymous exact checkout of $strSha" -InformationAction Continue
+      - name: Verify checkout credential cleanup
+        timeout-minutes: 2
+        id: verify-checkout-credentials
+        shell: pwsh
+        env:
+          GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1"
+          GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: /dev/null
+          GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0"
+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+
+          # Do not load user/system Git credentials or hooks during anonymous acquisition.
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_COUNT) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: external Git command configuration is not allowed'
+          }
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM = '1'
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL = '/dev/null'
+          $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT = '0'
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GITHUB_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GH_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: a token was projected into a code job'
+          }
+          # git config exits 1 when a queried key is absent, which is the secure
+          # expected state this step asserts. If the runner enables native-command
+          # error mapping, that accepted status would terminate the step before the
+          # explicit capture below runs, so it is disabled the same way
+          # markdownlint.yml disables it.
+          if (Test-Path Variable:PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference) {
+              $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
+          }
+          # Resolved here too. Constants do not cross step boundaries, and this
+          # step asserts a credential property, so the executable it asks must
+          # not be chosen by name resolution either.
+          $strResolvedGit = @('/usr/bin/git', '/bin/git') | Where-Object { [System.IO.File]::Exists($_) } | Select-Object -First 1
+          if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($strResolvedGit)) { throw 'credential-policy: Git was not resolved as an application' }
+          New-Variable -Name strGitPath -Value $strResolvedGit -Option Constant
+          $arrRemoteUrls = @(& $strGitPath remote get-url --all origin)
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $arrRemoteUrls.Count -ne 1) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: unable to resolve exactly one origin URL'
+          }
+          if ($arrRemoteUrls[0] -cne 'https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide') {
+              throw 'credential-policy: origin is not a credential-free GitHub HTTPS URL'
+          }
+          $arrHelpers = @(& $strGitPath config --local --get-all credential.helper)
+          $intHelperExit = $LASTEXITCODE
+          $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
+          if (($intHelperExit -ne 0 -and $intHelperExit -ne 1) -or $arrHelpers.Count -ne 0) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: a local credential helper is configured'
+          }
+          $arrAuthorizationKeys = @(& $strGitPath config --local --name-only --get-regexp '^http\..*\.extraheader$')
+          $intAuthorizationExit = $LASTEXITCODE
+          $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
+          if (($intAuthorizationExit -ne 0 -and $intAuthorizationExit -ne 1) -or $arrAuthorizationKeys.Count -ne 0) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: persisted HTTP authorization is configured'
+          }
+
+          $arrEffectiveConfig = @(& $strGitPath config --show-scope --name-only --list)
+          $intEffectiveConfigExit = $LASTEXITCODE
+          if ($intEffectiveConfigExit -ne 0 -or @($arrEffectiveConfig | Where-Object { $_ -cmatch '^(system|global)\s' }).Count -ne 0) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: external Git configuration was not excluded'
+          }
+
+      - name: Acquire published main reference
+        timeout-minutes: 5
+        shell: pwsh
+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+
+          # Do not load user/system Git credentials or hooks during anonymous acquisition.
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_COUNT) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: external Git command configuration is not allowed'
+          }
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM = '1'
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL = '/dev/null'
+          $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT = '0'
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GITHUB_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GH_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: a token was projected into a code job'
+          }
+          # git reports absent state with a non-zero status in places this step
+          # accepts, so native-command error mapping is disabled the same way
+          # the other governed steps disable it and each status is classified
+          # explicitly instead.
+          if (Test-Path Variable:PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference) {
+              $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
+          }
+
+          $strGitPath = @('/usr/bin/git', '/bin/git') | Where-Object {
+              [IO.File]::Exists($_)
+          } | Select-Object -First 1
+          if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($strGitPath)) {
+              throw 'main: fixed Git is unavailable'
+          }
+          $arrUrls = @(& $strGitPath remote get-url --all origin)
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $arrUrls.Count -ne 1 -or
+              $arrUrls[0] -cne 'https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide') {
+              throw 'main: origin identity is invalid'
+          }
+          for ($intAttempt = 1; $intAttempt -le 3; $intAttempt++) {
+              & $strGitPath -c credential.helper= -c http.extraheader= -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null fetch --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules origin refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main
+              $intFetchExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
+              if ($intFetchExitCode -eq 0) {
+                  break
+              }
+              if ($intAttempt -lt 3) {
+                  Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
+              }
+          }
+          if ($intFetchExitCode -ne 0) {
+              throw "main: git fetch exited $intFetchExitCode after three attempts"
+          }
+          $arrMain = @(& $strGitPath rev-parse --verify refs/remotes/origin/main)
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $arrMain.Count -ne 1 -or
+              $arrMain[0] -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$' -or $arrMain[0] -ceq ('0' * 40)) {
+              throw 'main: expected one nonzero commit identity'
+          }
+          $strMain = $arrMain[0]
+          $arrType = @(& $strGitPath cat-file -t $strMain)
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $arrType.Count -ne 1 -or $arrType[0] -cne 'commit') {
+              throw 'main: fetched authority is not a commit'
+          }
+          $arrHead = @(& $strGitPath rev-parse HEAD)
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $arrHead.Count -ne 1 -or $arrHead[0] -cne $env:GITHUB_SHA) {
+              throw 'main: event checkout changed during authority acquisition'
+          }
+          Write-Information "main: setup-time authority $strMain; event checkout $env:GITHUB_SHA" -InformationAction Continue
+
+      - name: Reject alternate npm install inputs
+        timeout-minutes: 2
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1"
+          GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: /dev/null
+          GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0"
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          if [[ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ||
+            -n "${ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GIT_CONFIG_COUNT:-}" ||
+            -n "${GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS:-}" ]]; then
+            echo '::error::Unexpected credential or Git configuration channel.'
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
+          declare -ar alternate_inputs=(
+            .npmrc
+            npm-shrinkwrap.json
+            .github/workflows/.npmrc
+            .github/workflows/npm-shrinkwrap.json
+          )
+          for alternate_input in "${alternate_inputs[@]}"; do
+            if [[ -e "${alternate_input}" || -L "${alternate_input}" ]]; then
+              echo "::error file=${alternate_input}::Unsupported npm" \
+                'install input.'
+              exit 1
+            fi
+          done
+
+      - name: Detect locked validation-tool layout
+        timeout-minutes: 2
+        id: toolchain
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1"
+          GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: /dev/null
+          GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0"
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          if [[ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ||
+            -n "${ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GIT_CONFIG_COUNT:-}" ||
+            -n "${GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS:-}" ]]; then
+            echo '::error::Unexpected credential or Git configuration channel.'
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
+          workflow_manifest='.github/workflows/package.json'
+          workflow_lock='.github/workflows/package-lock.json'
+
+          for required_file in "${workflow_manifest}" "${workflow_lock}"; do
+            if [[ ! -f "${required_file}" || -L "${required_file}" ]]; then
+              echo "::error file=${required_file}::Required locked npm input" \
+                'is missing or is not a regular file.'
+              exit 1
+            fi
+          done
+
+          classify_npm_input() {
+            if [[ -L "$1" ]]; then
+              printf 'symlink'
+            elif [[ -f "$1" ]]; then
+              printf 'regular-file'
+            elif [[ -e "$1" ]]; then
+              printf 'non-regular'
+            else
+              printf 'absent'
+            fi
+          }
+
+          root_manifest_state="$(classify_npm_input package.json)"
+          root_lock_state="$(classify_npm_input package-lock.json)"
+
+          if [[ "${root_manifest_state}" == regular-file && \
+            "${root_lock_state}" == regular-file ]]; then
+            echo 'layout=modern' >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
+          elif [[ "${root_manifest_state}" == absent && \
+            "${root_lock_state}" == absent ]]; then
+            echo 'layout=legacy' >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
+          else
+            echo '::error::The root npm validation tuple requires both inputs as' \
+              'regular files or both inputs absent;' \
+              "package.json=${root_manifest_state};" \
+              "package-lock.json=${root_lock_state}."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+
+          declaration='.github/workflows/ci-toolchain.json'
+          declaration_state="$(classify_npm_input "${declaration}")"
+          python_lock_state="$(classify_npm_input requirements-dev.txt)"
+          launcher_state="$(classify_npm_input .github/workflows/Invoke-LockedPythonHook.ps1)"
+          capability='full'
+          version=''
+          if [[ "${root_manifest_state}" == absent ]]; then
+            if [[ "${declaration_state}" != absent || "${python_lock_state}" != absent || "${launcher_state}" != absent ]]; then
+              echo '::error::Legacy npm layout has partial current validation inputs.'
+              exit 1
+            fi
+            capability='node-only'
+          elif [[ "${declaration_state}" == absent ]]; then
+            # PowerShell variables are intentionally literal to Bash.
+            # shellcheck disable=SC2016
+            version="$(pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command '
+              $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
+              $obj = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath package.json | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
+              if ($obj.engines.npm -cne "11.16.0" -or $obj.engines.node -cnotin @("24.18.0", "24.18.1")) {
+                  throw "Unsupported pre-declaration runtime tuple"
+              }
+              Write-Output $obj.engines.node')"
+            if [[ "${version}" == 24.18.0 && "${python_lock_state}" == absent && "${launcher_state}" == absent ]]; then
+              capability='node-only'
+            fi
+          elif [[ "${declaration_state}" != regular-file ]]; then
+            echo '::error::Runtime declaration is not a regular file.'
+            exit 1
+          else
+            # shellcheck disable=SC2016
+            pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command '
+              $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
+              $null = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath .github/workflows/ci-toolchain.json | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop'
+          fi
+          if [[ "${capability}" == full ]]; then
+            installer_state="$(classify_npm_input .github/workflows/install-husky.mjs)"
+            if [[ "${declaration_state}" == absent && "${version}" == 24.18.1 && "${installer_state}" == absent ]]; then
+              # Retain the evidenced historical command, not an arbitrary missing-input fallback.
+              # shellcheck disable=SC2016
+              pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command '
+                $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
+                $obj = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath .github/workflows/package.json | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
+                if ($obj.scripts.prepare -isnot [string] -or $obj.scripts.prepare -cne "cd ../.. && husky") {
+                    throw "Historical full setup requires the exact retained prepare command"
+                }'
+              echo 'Retained historical Husky prepare command selected.'
+            elif [[ "${installer_state}" != regular-file ]]; then
+              echo '::error::Full validation requires a regular current Husky installer.'
+              exit 1
+            fi
+            for required_file in requirements-dev.txt .github/workflows/Invoke-LockedPythonHook.ps1 \
+              .pre-commit-config.yaml .husky/pre-commit \
+              .github/workflows/lint-staged-markdown.mjs; do
+              if [[ "$(classify_npm_input "${required_file}")" != regular-file ]]; then
+                echo "::error file=${required_file}::Full validation requires a regular input."
+                exit 1
+              fi
+            done
+            echo 'Full Node/Python/hook preparation selected.'
+          else
+            echo 'Historical Node-only preparation selected; Python and full validation are unavailable for this tree.'
+          fi
+          printf 'validation=%s\n' "${capability}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
+
+
+      - name: Verify acquired immutable setup inputs
+        timeout-minutes: 2
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          if [[ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ||
+            -n "${ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GIT_CONFIG_COUNT:-}" ||
+            -n "${GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS:-}" ]]; then
+            echo '::error::Unexpected credential or Git configuration channel.'
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
+          declare -ar setup_inputs=(
+            package.json package-lock.json .github/workflows/package.json .github/workflows/package-lock.json
+            .github/workflows/ci-toolchain.json requirements-dev.txt .github/workflows/Invoke-LockedPythonHook.ps1
+            .pre-commit-config.yaml .github/workflows/install-husky.mjs .husky/pre-commit
+            .github/workflows/lint-staged-markdown.mjs
+          )
+          git diff --cached --exit-code HEAD -- "${setup_inputs[@]}"
+          git diff --exit-code HEAD -- "${setup_inputs[@]}"
+          untracked_inputs="$(git ls-files --others -- "${setup_inputs[@]}")"
+          if [[ -n "${untracked_inputs}" ]]; then
+            printf '::error::Untracked setup inputs changed: %s\n' "${untracked_inputs}"
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+      - name: Set up verified official Node.js runtime
+        timeout-minutes: 8
+        shell: pwsh
+        env:
+          GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1"
+          GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: /dev/null
+          GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0"
+          TOOLCHAIN_LAYOUT: ${{ steps.toolchain.outputs.layout }}
+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+          if (Test-Path Variable:PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference) {
+              $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
+          }
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GITHUB_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GH_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: a token was projected into a code job'
+          }
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_COUNT) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: external Git command configuration is not allowed'
+          }
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM = '1'
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL = '/dev/null'
+          $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT = '0'
+          $strDigestSource = 'copilot-setup-steps.yml retained runtime digest'
+          if ($env:TOOLCHAIN_LAYOUT -ceq 'legacy') {
+              $strVersion = '20.20.2'
+              $strReviewedSha256 = 'DF770B2A6F130ED8627C9782C988FDA9669FA23898329A61A871E32F965E007D'
+          } elseif ($env:TOOLCHAIN_LAYOUT -ceq 'modern') {
+              if (Test-Path -LiteralPath '.github/workflows/ci-toolchain.json') {
+                  $objRuntimePin = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath '.github/workflows/ci-toolchain.json' | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
+                  $objPackage = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'package.json' | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
+                  $strVersion = $objPackage.engines.node
+                  $strReviewedSha256 = $objRuntimePin.linuxX64Sha256.ToUpperInvariant()
+                  $strDigestSource = 'package.json engines.node and .github/workflows/ci-toolchain.json linuxX64Sha256'
+              } else {
+                  # Preserve service setup for published branches from before the shared declaration.
+                  $objPackage = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'package.json' | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
